property.name: fieldPath
property.label: Field API Path
property.description: Full field path to watch, e.g. Opportunity.StageName or Case.Status

property.name: triggerValue
property.label: Trigger Value
property.description: The field value that triggers confetti, e.g. Closed Won or Resolved

property.name: themeName
property.label: Confetti Theme (API Name, not Label)
property.description: Paste the API Name of a Confetti Theme record — NOT its Label. The API Name uses underscores instead of spaces, e.g. the theme labelled 'Green Yellow' has the API Name Green_Yellow. Find it in Setup > Custom Metadata Types > Confetti Theme > Manage Records, in the 'Confetti Theme Name' column. Ships with: Green_Yellow, Rainbow — paste one of these, or the API Name of your own new theme record.
